tools.title: Prepare Sandbox Workspace
tools.description: Materialize explicitly selected SourceWeft DB-backed VFS /workfiles Workfile content as ordinary provider sandbox files under provider-allowed prepare target roots. Put generated code, data files, plans, and QA notes in /workfiles first, then prepare only files needed for sandbox execution. /kb and /skills are SourceWeft DB-backed VFS roots, not transfer sources.

tools.title: Execute Sandbox Command
tools.description: Execute a shell command in the provider sandbox filesystem. Never include SourceWeft DB-backed VFS logical paths such as /workfiles, /kb, or /skills in an execute command; they are not sandbox paths even for mkdir, ls, cat, test, node, python, or shell redirection. Use prepare_sandbox_workspace to materialize selected Workfiles under provider sandbox paths before execution. Files that SourceWeft must later read, inspect, collect, or publish must be written under the current provider read/write roots.

tools.title: Collect Sandbox Outputs
tools.description: Persist explicitly selected provider sandbox text outputs from provider-allowed collect source roots into SourceWeft DB-backed VFS /workfiles Workfiles. Do not use this tool for binary outputs such as .pptx, .pdf, .zip, or .xlsx files; publish binary outputs with publish_artifact using artifactType=slides for PPTX decks or artifactType=file for generic downloadable files.
